Mapping/labels: https://www.inegi.org.mx/contenidos/programas/ensu/datosabiertos/conjunto_de_datos_ensu_2024_1t_csv.zip (sha256 9361396d16532018474e62d3281ccf2dac0c006c6d4b10c3fd83bc3cb5c8bd39), conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0324/diccionario_de_datos/diccionario_de_datos_ensu_cb_0324.csv (variable labels, sha256 db59964dc3937e20f2b3711acfb80bcc5815f1cbf96c6df5fb41bf5aeeb75d3e) and catalogos/bp2_*.csv (value labels). Rights: instrument_rights_register.csv INEGI row verdict=ship (Ben 2026-09-23, irw#2381 R01; INEGI Terminos de libre uso, attribution only), applied not re-derived; credit condition applied in public_note.
note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #19) keeps INEGI columns bp2_1..bp2_4_11 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0324.csv (lowercased) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's own data dictionary labels each BP2_* column (e.g. BP2_2_16 'Conflictos o enfrentamientos: Grafiti o pintas a su casa por alguien que usted identifique'; BP2_3_4 'Incidentes o problemas con desconocidos(as) en la calle'; BP2_4_09 'Tipo de consecuencias derivadas de conflictos: Dialogo o platica'), 37/37 labels agree in content with the questionnaire option carrying the same code number. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 37 live item vectors reproduce the raw INEGI Q1 2024 CSV cell for cell after the .do's recodes (74/74 item x level counts, e.g. bp2_1 1/2 = 8659/15340, bp2_2_16 0/1 = 8153/506, bp2_4_09 0/1 = 3652/3798); 23 bp2_1=9 and 36 bp2_3_*=9 codes were set missing by the .do. Words: item_text / section_prompt / instructions are the administered questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials), not the terser dictionary labels (which differ trivially: 'uso del taladro' vs printed 'uso de taladro'; 'etc.' vs 'etcetera'; BP2_4_05 lacks '(palos, varillas, tubos, etcetera)'; 'Dialogo o platica' vs printed 'Dialogo / platica'). 8 of 38 distinct Spanish strings (CP2, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3 and 2.4 stems, 2.2 options 01, 12, 16) are missing or fragmentary in the PDF's text layer (bold font not extracted) and were transcribed from 200/300 dpi renders of pages 3-4 -- spot-check those; the other 30 are exact substrings of pdftotext output. Kept as printed: 2.2 stem's typo 'familares' (sic; 2.1 and CP2 spell 'familiares'), the '(as)' gender fills, trailing '?' on 2.2 options and the stem's trailing '...'. Normalised: CP2 line-break hyphen 'trabajo/es-cuela' joined to 'trabajo/escuela'; double space in option 04 'morosidad  en' collapsed; line wraps joined with a space. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blanks after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'B' Y CIRCULE UN SOLO CODIGO / LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; PASE A LA SECCION III; SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 18 'NINGUNO', PASE A LA SECCION III). Structure: section _1 = 2.1 (the screener; stem in item_text), _2 = 2.2 (conflict types, stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _3 = 2.3 (with whom), _4 = 2.4 (consequences); instructions = the CP2 read-aloud introduction to Section II (whole-table framing). Options: bp2_1 1=Si, 2=No (questionnaire and catalogo bp2_1.csv; 9 'No sabe / no responde' set missing by the .do, no row). The 36 checklist items are 0/1 flags for a circled code; option_text for them is INEGI's catalogo value label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si', identical in all 36 catalogos), not questionnaire print, since the questionnaire prints no response scale for a circled checklist code. Every level each item's respondents used has an option row. Routing (not a defect): 2.2 asked only if 2.1=Si (n=8659 = bp2_1 Si count); 2.3/2.4 skipped when 2.2 code 18 'Ninguno' was circled (7450 = 8659 - 1209). Step 3b: live items match this question block exactly (37 = 1 + 18 + 7 + 11); dictionary Description is accurate, but the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while the data and wording are the 2024 Q1 (marzo 2024, file suffix 0324) wave. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation); INEGI publishes no English questionnaire. Generalisation (siblings not touched): the same zip per quarter (conjunto_de_datos_ensu_2024_{2,3,4}t_csv.zip) and ensu2024_trim{2,3,4}_cuest_principal.pdf in the same questionnaire zip should serve the q2-q4 conflicts tables; the text layer drops bold stems there too, so plan on reading page renders.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2024, primer trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section II (questions 2.1-2.4) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
